[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-qx[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Soft-disabled LLM providers and a launch guard for hard-disabled [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]ones[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A provider can be put in a soft disable that spares it in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]load-balanced pools while another member can cover, never triggers [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a `||` fallback, and still runs when an agent asks for it by name —[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and any launch that truly needs a hard-disabled provider is caught [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]before an agent spawns, with an ACE panel that offers a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one-keypress way out (enable, soft-enable, pick another model, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]abort this agent, abort the launch).[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]soft_provider_disables.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/soft_provider_disables.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-qx[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-qx/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Provider-disable mode on the Rust wire[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-mode[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-mode: add the hard/soft `mode` field to the sase-core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]provider-disable record, bump the wire schema to 2 with a v1 migration [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that keeps in-flight disables as hard, and thread the mode through the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]set/try-set bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mode-aware routing policy[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]routing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-mode[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]routing: teach the Python routing layer the three-state member [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]availability (preferred / sparing / unavailable), spare soft members in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`|` pools only while a preferred member exists, keep soft members [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]winning `||` fallbacks, and stop soft disables from raising, pausing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overrides, or blocking retries.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Launch Control soft-disable workflow[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]provider-ui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after routing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]provider-ui: add the `s` soft-disable action and mode-aware rendering to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Provider Routing, keep the current window when flipping mode, show [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sparing state in the Launch Control rows, top-bar pill, model picker, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and `%model` completion, and document all of it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fail-closed launch guard[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]after routing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard-core: enumerate the launch units one prompt will spawn, refuse [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before any spawn when a unit can only run on a hard-disabled provider, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and accept an ACE-resolved unit bundle through the `sase run` request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]payload.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The ACE disabled-provider launch panel[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard-panel[dim] · [dim][/dim]after provider-ui, guard-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard-panel: run the guard before ACE submits a launch and resolve each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocked unit in sequence through a single-keypress panel offering [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enable, soft-enable, per-provider enable, another model, abort this [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent, and abort the whole launch.[/#D7D7AF]
